title: Freeze recovery inventory class contract and quarantine record
description: Objective: resolve the current contradictory inventory cardinality and define the durable fail-closed reconciliation/quarantine record the coordinator can persist. Deliverable: one canonical daemon recovery-inventory contract that maps every detailed external population to exactly one configured proof class, defines ABSENT/ADOPTED/QUARANTINED/UNKNOWN dispositions and upstream-code retention, and provides a frozen digest-verified persisted record bound to project, backup cursor/generation, selected incarnation/key epoch and quarantine refs. MEASURED GAP at HEAD c0c5929: design line 978 names seven populations, CORE-S14 names six grouped categories, @moe/runner exposes four combined node classes, adding scheduler resource yields five proof classes, the coordinator description lists six groups, and DoD demands seven generated classes; the runner collector rejects unknown/extra classes. No production quarantine/reconciliation record or sink exists. Consumer: task-cf7fb147bd1c47698cbd65c9535370aa and downstream task-6f786c58cabf4f85be8ed4135e68a752. NOT in scope: enumerating providers, invoking adapters, allocating authority, or approving recovery.complete. Owned paths: focused daemon recovery contract/codec/persistence modules and tests, plus minimal store schema only if required. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm --filter @moe/store test.
definitionOfDone: A frozen hand-written class/population mapping resolves the 4-runner/5-proof/6-scenario/7-population ambiguity: every design population is covered exactly once, no proof is duplicated to inflate cardinality, and unknown/duplicate/omitted/extra classes refuse with stable code/layer.

The contract defines canonical ABSENT, ADOPTED, QUARANTINED and UNKNOWN dispositions; ADOPTED requires exact restored intent plus current incarnation/key epoch, unmatched items can only quarantine/UNKNOWN, and no disposition invents history or retry authority.

A durable frozen reconciliation record binds project, backup cursor and generation, selected incarnation and key epoch, configured class mapping, source proof digests, every item disposition, retained upstream code/layer and quarantine refs; any byte change changes or invalidates its digest.

Missing inventory, incomplete coverage, non-fenceable state, artifact/key proof failure and unresolved items persist truth UNKNOWN with coordinator code UNKNOWN_TRUTH at RECOVERY_INVENTORY while retaining the precise upstream code/layer separately.
Persistence/reopen and hostile-byte tests drive the real store/codec surface, assert exact cardinalities and stable code/layer, and generated cases assert a non-zero exact population count.

Mutation drills alter canonical digest input and one adoption/incarnation comparison and turn named tests red; fresh pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm --filter @moe/store test exits 0.
taskRails: Do not satisfy the seven-population requirement by duplicating a combined runner proof; the mapping must be explicit and one-to-one at the semantic population level.
Do not narrow the design or accept caller-selected current binding; use exact selected store/anchor authority in consumers.
Retain upstream code and layer separately from the coordinator UNKNOWN_TRUTH/RECOVERY_INVENTORY answer; never restamp away provenance.
Shared schema changes require full regression and crash/reopen evidence.
Target <=250 physical lines per production source and split before 400; the cap is per file.

implementationPlan.description: Reconfirm the planning baseline before edits: verify the pinned design hash, re-read design lines 978/1201, run the bare `@moe/runner` probe, and record the owned-path and repo-gate failing-path baseline. Lock the measured contract in the work note as six unique proof classes covering seven semantic populations (one and only one shared proof: `PROVIDER_PROCESS_LAUNCH_LOCK` covers lock registrations and provider runs); stop rather than edit if the public root or owned paths have drifted.

TDD red: add focused record/codec and ledger tests against the planned production imports. Pin the exact six-class/ seven-population hand-written mapping and nonzero cardinalities; exact `EXTRA`, `UNKNOWN`, `DUPLICATE`, and `OMITTED` mapping refusal codes at layer `RECOVERY_INVENTORY`; every disposition arm (including design-required terminal `CANCELLED` alongside task-required `ABSENT`, `ADOPTED`, `QUARANTINED`, `UNKNOWN`); stale-incarnation and stale-key adoption refusals; UNKNOWN normalization with separately retained upstream code/layer; canonical field/digest mutations; nested freeze and secret absence. Add real temporary-file `SqliteEventStore` tests for exact replay, two-handle contention, close/reopen, missing/corrupt/truncated/extra-event evidence, and assert every generated sweep ran its exact nonzero case count. Run only these tests and record the expected missing-module/red failures.

Implement the focused contract and exact LF NodeNext bridge. Freeze ordered proof classes as `PROVIDER_PROCESS_LAUNCH_LOCK`, `RESOURCE`, `WORKSPACE`, `INTEGRATION_TARGET`, `GIT_INTEGRATION_ON_DISK`, `ARTIFACT_OBJECT_STAGING`; freeze the seven design populations and the explicit class-to-population rows, with only the provider class containing two populations. Define closed proof/truth/disposition/result vocabularies, precise mapping error codes (`RECOVERY_INVENTORY_CLASS_EXTRA|UNKNOWN|DUPLICATE|OMITTED`), coordinator `UNKNOWN_TRUTH`, layer `RECOVERY_INVENTORY`, ledger upstream codes/layer, bounds, and immutable record/input/result types. Model terminal cancellation explicitly without granting retry/history authority; do not let Git/submodule evidence certify durable integration attempts or artifact-object evidence certify scheduler resources.

Implement total record normalization/adjudication and its exact LF bridge. Validate hostile inputs with own enumerable data descriptors before property access; require the exact configured six-class set and normalize a missing/incomplete configured proof into its canonical UNKNOWN proof slot rather than shrinking the mapping. Bind each subject to its one mapped proof, project/project-tag, verified backup cursor+generation, selected anchor binding digest/incarnation/key epoch, source proof digest, restored-intent reference/digest, terminal proof or quarantine reference, disposition, and separate coordinator/upstream refusal tuples. Enforce: ABSENT only from complete negative proof; CANCELLED only from terminal cancellation proof; ADOPTED only when external/restored identity and both selected recovery refs match exactly; unmatched items only QUARANTINED or UNKNOWN; any incomplete/non-fenceable/artifact-or-key/unresolved fact makes the persisted truth `UNKNOWN_TRUTH`/`RECOVERY_INVENTORY`. Deep-freeze copied data and expose no secret/message bytes.

Implement the strict canonical codec and exact LF bridge. Encode a versioned, fixed-key-order, bounded UTF-8 JSON body with deterministic class/population/item ordering; compute SHA-256 over every body field except `recordDigest`, then append that digest. Decode with fatal UTF-8, exact keys/vocabularies/bounds/cardinalities, re-derived six-to-seven mapping and disposition invariants, digest recomputation, and byte-for-byte canonical re-encoding so whitespace, key order, duplicate keys, extensions, truncation, or any semantic byte mutation cannot become an alternate authoritative record. Return the stable unreadable upstream code/layer under coordinator UNKNOWN rather than throwing or defaulting.

Implement content-addressed durable persistence/readback and its exact LF bridge using only the existing public `SqliteEventStore` transaction surface—no schema change or raw SQLite. The write service must read the fixed ACTIVE recovery binding from the project store and the exact anchored incarnation, cross-check key epoch/project/backup generation, and only then build the record; it must accept no request-selected current refs. Commit canonical bytes once under a domain-separated record-digest aggregate with command kind `recovery.reconcile_external`, expectedVersion 0, exact domain schema/event IDs, and identical request/result/event bytes; exact retries replay one event. The reader addresses an explicit record digest (never an invented 'latest'), verifies the sole sequence-1 event plus decision trace/decision bytes and codec/digest/aggregate identity, and maps absent, conflicting, malformed, or unverifiable evidence to `UNKNOWN_TRUTH`/`RECOVERY_INVENTORY` while retaining `RECORD_NOT_FOUND|UNREADABLE|CONFLICT` at `RECOVERY_INVENTORY_LEDGER`. R3 may later bind this immutable digest; this task grants no recovery.complete authority.

Adversarial review the owned diff as a trust boundary. Confirm each production source targets <=250 lines and remains below 400, all four bridges are exact LF one-liners, caller objects are never frozen/mutated, combined proofs are stored once, no COMPLETE resource/integration proof is synthesized, no raw credential/key/nonce/message is serialized, and Windows tests close both store handles before reopen/delete. Perform byte-restored mutation drills that (a) delete one population/mapping edge, (b) omit a bound body leaf from the digest, (c) bypass recovery-incarnation equality, and (d) bypass key-epoch equality; require each named production-surface test to turn red, restore exact bytes, and rerun the focused tests green.

Run the single final foreground gate and capture fresh exit codes/output: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test && pnpm --filter @moe/store test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm verify:foundation && pnpm verify:store`. Compare repo-wide failures with the recorded merge-base failing-path baseline, require zero new failures intersecting the owned recovery paths and all owned-package legs green, report any foreign red verbatim, verify the final diff contains only the ten explicit owned paths, and hand QA the record digest/replay/reopen evidence plus consumer IDs `task-47eecd22b3b94a57a9632672c19ebd97`, `task-cf7fb147bd1c47698cbd65c9535370aa`, and downstream `task-6f786c58cabf4f85be8ed4135e68a752`.

reopenReason: Fresh foreground verification is green, but adversarial production-surface probes reproduced three fail-closed gaps. The builder silently accepts unknown and duplicate supplied proof-class rows, accepts a subject whose sourceProofDigest contradicts its mapped COMPLETE proof and still returns truth COMPLETE, and lets a throwing Proxy trap escape instead of returning the stable typed refusal. These gaps violate the closed-class contract and allow unverifiable provenance to gain COMPLETE truth. Validate supplied proof rows as a closed unique set, cross-link each subject digest to its mapped proof, contain/reject proxies before reflective access, and add exact code/layer regressions against the production builder.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: SEVEN PROOF ROWS — rejected: it duplicates the one combined runner proof merely to inflate cardinality. FIVE PROOFS BY FOLDING DURABLE INTEGRATION INTO GIT — rejected: the landed Git adapter proves refs/submodules, not durable integration attempts. FOLDING RESOURCE INTO ARTIFACT — rejected: object/staging enumeration is not scheduler resource authority. EXTENDING THE RUNNER CLASS UNION/COLLECTOR — rejected: its four node-side classes are already a closed, focused 378-line aggregate and task-47 is allowed to deliver two daemon typed proof bridges without reversing dependency direction. A CUSTOM SQLITE TABLE — rejected: the existing expected-version decision/event transaction provides replay, reopen, and strict readback without shared-schema churn. A MUTABLE 'LATEST' RECORD — rejected as unspecified authority: records are immutable/content-addressed and the later R3 decision binds an explicit digest. ONLY FOUR DISPOSITIONS — rejected as a narrowing of the pinned design, whose line 978 explicitly distinguishes terminal cancellation; CANCELLED is therefore represented as a proof-bearing, zero-retry terminal disposition alongside the four task-named values.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Fresh measurement at HEAD 0371ead86fc0355a4929a04564296e9cfba573db: `(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 D:/projexts/moes/docs/plans/2026-08-05-moe-rebuild-design.md).Hash` returned exactly 1D9D1EC97D3F07247FBBC088045E0BA2FD6DA8307F10A9026C55106419383191. Reading lines 978 and 1201 returned seven detailed populations and six scenario groups. A real child Node bare import from packages/runner printed `classes=[PROVIDER_PROCESS_LAUNCH_LOCK,WORKSPACE,GIT_INTEGRATION_ON_DISK,ARTIFACT_OBJECT_STAGING]` and all four published registration factories as functions. Production search for `RecoveryInventoryReconciliation|INTEGRATION_ATTEMPT|RESOURCE_EFFECT|RecoveryInventory.*Recorded` returned NO_PRODUCTION_MATCHES, confirming that the two supplemental proofs, canonical mapping, and durable record remain absent. The owned daemon recovery/store path status was clean. Moe re-measurement shows task-fb997 is DONE, while task-47eecd22 is BLOCKED specifically until this mapping lands. The honest canonical invariant is 4 landed runner proofs -> +RESOURCE = 5 -> +INTEGRATION_TARGET = 6 unique proof records -> 7 flattened semantic populations, with the combined provider proof stored once.
planningNotes.risks: The runner registration factories preserve only aggregate inventory code/layer, not the deeper Git/artifact observer refusal; retain exactly what production exposes and never invent deeper provenance. `readCurrentRecoveryAuthenticationBinding` collapses missing/unreadable to null, so the ledger must fail closed with a local upstream code rather than claim a selected binding. The record builder may structurally compare restored-intent bindings, but only task-cf7's real durable consumer may supply those intents; this slice must not claim it discovers them. Missing configured evidence is a valid persisted UNKNOWN slot, whereas a malformed configured class set is a structural refusal—do not conflate the two. Canonical JSON must reject alternate bytes after parse, including duplicate-key/whitespace/key-order variants. Content-addressed persistence intentionally supplies no current/latest selection and no recovery completion authority. Preserve foreign work and stage/commit only the ten named paths.

issues.description: normaliseProofs uses supplied.find and silently discards all unmatched rows. Production probes with a seventh proof {class:'ALIEN', ...} and with a duplicate of proofs[0] both returned ok:true, truth:'COMPLETE', proofCount:6. Validate the supplied proof array itself; refuse unknown, duplicate, and extra class rows with distinct stable RECOVERY_INVENTORY code/layer, and add production-surface tests that pin which guard answered.

A subject is adjudicated without verifying subject.sourceProofDigest equals the sourceProofDigest of its mapped configured proof. Mutating only the first subject digest to deadbeef... while its class proof remained c0... returned ok:true and truth:'COMPLETE', persisting contradictory provenance. Fail closed (typed refusal or UNKNOWN as specified) with an exact reason/layer and test a positive nonzero sweep across mapped classes.

exactDataRecord invokes Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors on unknown input without Proxy containment. A Proxy whose ownKeys throws caused buildRecoveryReconciliationRecord to throw 'trap-executed', contradicting the claimed hostile-input refusal and the stable-result rail. Reject transparent proxies and contain throwing/revoked proxies before reflective traps; assert immutable UNKNOWN_TRUTH/RECOVERY_INVENTORY with upstream RECOVERY_INVENTORY_INPUT_INVALID/RECOVERY_INVENTORY.
